NOTICE INVITING TENDER No. DWS/GHI/07/2026 dated 01.09.2026
Issued by: District Welfare Society, 4th Floor, Collectorate Complex, Warangal - 506001.
Purpose: Group health insurance for 1,200 contract staff and their dependants.
Clause 2 (Contract period): 01.12.2026 to 30.11.2027.
Clause 3 (Portal): Bids to be submitted online at https://tender.example.gov.in only.
Clause 4 (Schedule): Pre-bid meeting 20.09.2026 at 11:00 AM in the Collectorate conference hall. Last date for submission 05.10.2026 at 3:00 PM. Technical bids opened 06.10.2026 at 11:00 AM at the Collectorate conference hall. Contact: Project Director, 0870-2500000, pd-dws@example.gov.in.
Clause 5 (Eligibility): 5.1 Insurer registered with IRDAI. 5.2 Minimum gross written premium of Rs.100 crore in each of the last three financial years. 5.3 MSE bidders are exempt from EMD but must upload a valid Udyam certificate.
Clause 6 (EMD): Rs.2,00,000 by demand draft in favour of the District Welfare Society. Tender fee Rs.5,000 (non-refundable).
Clause 7 (Scope): 7.1 Sum insured Rs.3,00,000 per family on floater basis. 7.2 Maternity benefit Rs.30,000 for normal delivery and Rs.50,000 for caesarean. 7.3 Pre-hospitalisation expenses for 30 days and post-hospitalisation for 60 days.
Clause 8 (Commercial): Premium inclusive of GST. Bid validity 90 days. Performance security 3% of annual premium. Payment of premium in two half-yearly instalments. Disputes subject to Warangal jurisdiction.
Clause 9 (Evaluation): Technical qualification on Clause 5; L1 on total annual premium among qualified bidders.
Clause 10 (Documents): IRDAI certificate, audited GWP statements for three years, EMD proof, Annexure B declaration. Hard copy of technical bid to reach the Collectorate by 07.10.2026, 5:00 PM.
ANNEXURE A - Benefit schedule
| Benefit | Limit |
| Maternity (normal / caesarean) | Rs.20,000 / Rs.40,000 |
| Pre-hospitalisation | 15 days |
| Post-hospitalisation | 60 days |
ANNEXURE B - Declaration of non-blacklisting on company letterhead.

## 1. Tender Overview
- **Issuing authority:** District Welfare Society, 4th Floor, Collectorate Complex, Warangal - 506001 [NIT]
- **Tender / notification no. and date:** DWS/GHI/07/2026 dated 01.09.2026 [NIT]
- **Purpose:** Group health insurance for 1,200 contract staff and their dependants [NIT]
- **Scope summary:** Floater health cover of Rs.3,00,000 per family including maternity and pre/post-hospitalisation benefits [Clause 7].
- **Contract period:** 01.12.2026 to 30.11.2027 [Clause 2]
- **Estimated value:** Not stated in the tender
- **Portal / mode of submission:** Online at https://tender.example.gov.in only [Clause 3]

## 2. Key Dates & Schedule
| Activity | Date & Time |
|---|---|
| Pre-bid meeting | 20.09.2026, 11:00 AM [Clause 4] |
| Last date for submission | 05.10.2026, 3:00 PM [Clause 4] |
| Technical bid opening | 06.10.2026, 11:00 AM [Clause 4] |
| Hard copy of technical bid | 07.10.2026, 5:00 PM [Clause 10] |
- **Place of opening:** Collectorate conference hall [Clause 4]
- **Contacts:** Project Director, 0870-2500000, pd-dws@example.gov.in [Clause 4]

## 3. Eligibility Criteria
1. Insurer registered with IRDAI [Clause 5.1]
2. Minimum gross written premium of Rs.100 crore in each of the last three financial years [Clause 5.2]
- **MSE bidders:** exempt from EMD; must upload a valid Udyam certificate [Clause 5.3]

## 4. Scope of Work / Deliverables
1. Sum insured Rs.3,00,000 per family on floater basis [Clause 7.1]
2. Maternity benefit Rs.30,000 normal delivery / Rs.50,000 caesarean [Clause 7.2]
3. Pre-hospitalisation 30 days; post-hospitalisation 60 days [Clause 7.3]

## 5. Commercial Terms
- **EMD / bid security, tender fee, processing fee and mode of payment:** EMD Rs.2,00,000 by demand draft; tender fee Rs.5,000 non-refundable [Clause 6]
- **Exemptions:** MSE bidders exempt from EMD [Clause 5.3]
- **Price basis and taxes:** Premium inclusive of GST [Clause 8]
- **Bid validity:** 90 days [Clause 8]
- **Agreement and performance security:** 3% of annual premium [Clause 8]
- **Penalties / liquidated damages:** Not stated in the tender
- **Payment terms:** Two half-yearly instalments [Clause 8]
- **Jurisdiction and dispute resolution:** Warangal [Clause 8]

## 6. Evaluation Process
Technical qualification on Clause 5 criteria, then L1 on total annual premium among qualified bidders [Clause 9].

## 7. Documents to be Submitted
- **Technical bid:** IRDAI certificate; audited GWP statements for three years; EMD proof [Clause 10]
- **Financial bid:** Not stated in the tender
- **Declarations / undertakings / formats:** Annexure B declaration [Clause 10]
- **Hard copies / physical submission:** Technical bid to the Collectorate by 07.10.2026, 5:00 PM [Clause 10]

## 8. Appendices & Annexures
### Annexure A - Benefit schedule
| Benefit | Limit |
|---|---|
| Maternity (normal / caesarean) | Rs.20,000 / Rs.40,000 |
| Pre-hospitalisation | 15 days |
| Post-hospitalisation | 60 days |
### Annexure B - Declaration
Declaration of non-blacklisting on company letterhead.

## 9. Discrepancies to Clarify at Pre-bid
| # | Topic | Value in one place [ref] | Conflicting value [ref] | Clarification to seek |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Maternity benefit | Rs.30,000 / Rs.50,000 [Clause 7.2] | Rs.20,000 / Rs.40,000 [Annexure A] | Which maternity limits are to be priced |
| 2 | Pre-hospitalisation | 30 days [Clause 7.3] | 15 days [Annexure A] | Which pre-hospitalisation period applies |
